mainStage.name: Maple Finance
mainStage.tier_overrides: DefiLlama tags as 'Lending' — reclassified as private-credit because loans go to institutional borrowers (real-world credit), not on-chain collateralised lending.
mainStage.one_liner: Institutional lending to real-world borrowers. Previously had defaults (2022); v2 restructured with better underwriting. Still private credit risk.

mainStage.name: Ondo USDY / OUSG
mainStage.one_liner: Ondo's US Treasury-backed yield tokens. USDY is permissionless on supported chains; OUSG is permissioned. Daily redemptions.

mainStage.name: BlackRock BUIDL
mainStage.one_liner: BlackRock's tokenized US Treasury fund. Daily redemptions, SEC-registered, Securitize as transfer agent.

mainStage.name: Hashnote USYC
mainStage.one_liner: Short-duration US Treasury fund via Hashnote. Institutional-grade, regulated wrapper, now under Circle.

mainStage.name: Ethena USDe / sUSDe
mainStage.tier_overrides: USDtb is partially backed by BUIDL, but the yield mechanism is synthetic (funding rate arbitrage). The delta-neutral basis trade is NOT a real-world asset — stays tier 4.
mainStage.one_liner: Delta-neutral basis trade — earns funding rates, NOT backed by real-world assets. Often appears in RWA listings but is a synthetic yield product.

mainStage.name: Centrifuge
mainStage.one_liner: Real-world credit pools on-chain — invoices, trade finance, structured credit. Epoch-based redemptions; counterparty risk on each pool.

flows.note: A platform for many pools; its largest pool token (JTRSY) is tracked under Anemoy.

mainStage.name: Hastra PRIME
mainStage.one_liner: Yield from Figure's home-equity loans (HELOCs), passed on through Hastra's PRIME token. Real US consumer credit from a listed lender; redemption terms are not clearly published.

mainStage.name: Usual USD0
mainStage.tier_overrides: Backed by T-bills but through a novel protocol structure with governance token. Less established than tier-1 issuers.
mainStage.one_liner: Treasury-backed stablecoin with yield redistribution via USUAL governance token. T-bill backing is real, but protocol structure is newer.

mainStage.name: Invesco USTB
mainStage.one_liner: Invesco's tokenized short-term Treasury bond ETF. Institutional pedigree, Securitize-distributed.

mainStage.name: Midas RWA
mainStage.one_liner: Euro and USD Treasury-backed tokens. EU-regulated issuer, multiple backing strategies including T-bills and basis yield.

mainStage.name: USD AI (sUSDai)
mainStage.tier_overrides: Calls itself a synthetic dollar, but the yield is from loans to GPU operators plus T-bills, not a basis trade.
mainStage.one_liner: Loans to AI companies, backed by their GPUs (70-80% loan-to-value, Delaware SPV), with the unlent cash in T-bills. Withdrawals go through a queue, not on demand.

mainStage.name: Ethena USDtb
mainStage.tier_overrides: Partially backed by BUIDL (BlackRock), but yield comes from the same basis-trade mechanism as USDe. The BUIDL backing does not make this an RWA — the yield source is synthetic.
mainStage.one_liner: Marketed as 'institutional USDe' with BUIDL backing, but yield is still from basis trades. Not a real-world asset despite the packaging.

mainStage.name: Re (reUSD)
mainStage.one_liner: Reinsurance-backed yield protocol. Novel backing type (reinsurance premiums). Limited track record, higher risk.

mainStage.name: Huma Finance
mainStage.one_liner: Payment financing and receivables on Solana. Newer protocol, growing TVL but limited track record. Private credit risk.

mainStage.name: OnRe ONyc
mainStage.tier_overrides: Reinsurance return on top of crypto-dollar collateral that includes sUSDe (Ethena), so the token carries both risks.
mainStage.one_liner: Reinsurance: the token's value rises as premiums are earned and falls when claims are paid (storms, disasters). The collateral is held in yield-bearing dollars (sUSDe, sUSDS, T-bills, syrupUSDC), so it also carries their risk.

mainStage.name: OpenTrade vaults
mainStage.one_liner: Stablecoin vaults backed by short US T-bills and money market funds, held through bankruptcy-remote SPVs. Mostly sold white-label inside fintech apps, not bought directly.

mainStage.name: R25 (rcUSD and credit pools)
mainStage.one_liner: Two kinds of product: rcUSD, a dollar token backed by tokenized money market funds and stablecoins, and fixed-term pools of emerging-market consumer credit (VRPC). R25 keeps an undisclosed spread.

mainStage.name: Plume Nest vaults
mainStage.one_liner: Vaults that hold other RWA products. About 56% is nOPAL: Brazilian card-installment receivables (BlackOpal). The rest is spread over nPRIME and smaller T-bill, credit and basis-carry vaults.

holds.name: BlackOpal LiquidStone II (Brazilian card receivables, via nOPAL)
Smaller Nest vaults (T-bills, credit, basis carry)

mainStage.name: Securitize Funds
mainStage.one_liner: Tokenized credit funds — Apollo CLO, Hamilton Lane senior credit. Institutional managers, Securitize as platform. Accredited investors only.

mainStage.name: Theo thUSD
mainStage.tier_overrides: Delta-neutral like Ethena, but the trade is in physical gold and CME futures, not crypto perps.
mainStage.one_liner: A dollar token earning a hedged gold carry trade (long physical gold, short CME gold futures, plus gold lending) and T-bills through Theo's thBILL. Minting and redeeming is for whitelisted firms only.

mainStage.name: Apyx apxUSD / apyUSD
mainStage.tier_overrides: Sold as a synthetic dollar, but backed by one company's preferred stock (Strategy's STRC). Traded as low as $0.70 when STRC fell.
mainStage.one_liner: A 'dollar' backed mostly (~82%) by Strategy's STRC preferred shares; the yield is their dividend. It lost up to 30% of its value when STRC fell, so it does not behave like a dollar.

mainStage.name: Valos vUSD
mainStage.one_liner: Loans to large crypto trading firms, run by a Finnish asset manager. Deposits in AUSD on Monad; loan data checked live through Accountable. Real credit risk, but the borrowers are crypto firms, not the real economy.

mainStage.name: Frax USD (frxUSD)
mainStage.one_liner: A stablecoin backed 1:1 by tokenized T-bill funds held at approved custodians (WisdomTree, Superstate, BlackRock BUIDL). Yield goes to sfrxUSD holders. Reserve reports are self-published, not audited.

mainStage.name: OpenEden TBILL
mainStage.one_liner: Tokenized US T-bill vault. Known issuer, regulated but BVI-domiciled — one notch below US-regulated wrappers.

mainStage.name: Ember vaults
mainStage.tier_overrides: About a third of the money is in RWA vaults (Bitwise Premium+, R25 Treasury), but most of it earns crypto yield (RockawayX Y10K, Ember Earn, basis and liquidity vaults), so the platform is rated as not RWA.
mainStage.one_liner: A shelf of about 29 vaults run by different managers. About a third is RWA: Bitwise's leveraged vault on Hastra PRIME, sUSDai and Huma PST, and R25's rcUSD. Most of the rest is crypto yield: RockawayX launch deals, lending loops and funding-rate trades.

holds.name: RockawayX Y10K (pre-deposits, launches, curated crypto lending)
Ember Earn (stablecoin lending spreads, leverage loops, funding-rate trades)
Smaller crypto vaults (SUI, BLUE, BTC, basis, concentrated liquidity)

mainStage.name: Sky RWA vaults
mainStage.one_liner: Not something you can buy: the old MakerDAO real-world loan vaults that back USDS (e.g. New Silver real-estate loans, Fortunafi). Shown so you know USDS holds them.

flows.note: Sky's own collateral vaults; there is no fund token to follow.

mainStage.name: VanEck Treasury Fund
mainStage.one_liner: VanEck's tokenized US T-bill fund, issued through Securitize. Daily redemptions, institutional investors only.

mainStage.name: stUSDT
mainStage.tier_overrides: Claims T-bill backing but opaque structure, tied to Justin Sun ecosystem. Auditing and transparency significantly below tier-1/2 standards.
mainStage.one_liner: Claims US Treasury backing but opaque issuer structure. Proceed with caution — transparency far below institutional standards.

mainStage.name: Anemoy funds (JTRSY and others)
mainStage.one_liner: Mostly the Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund (JTRSY): 0-3 month US T-bills in a BVI-regulated fund, daily USDC redemption, non-US professional investors only. The same issuer also runs smaller credit funds (Apollo credit, AAA CLO).

real-estate.name: RealT
real-estate.one_liner: Tokenized US rental properties. Each token is a share in an LLC holding a single property. Rental yield distributed weekly.

flows.note: Hundreds of single-property tokens, mostly on Gnosis.

real-estate.name: Lofty
real-estate.one_liner: Fractional US rental real estate. Similar model to RealT but on Algorand. Rental income distributed to token holders.

equity.name: Ondo Global Markets
equity.one_liner: Tokenized US equities — TSLA, NVDA, etc. on-chain. Not a yield product; equity exposure only.

flows.note: Many tokenized stocks, one token each; not a single fund token.
